title: The Receipt in the Pocket
story: Lila bought a blue jumper at the Saturday market. At home she saw a hole near the sleeve. She still had the receipt and the paper tag. On Monday she took the jumper back to the same stall. The seller, Owen, checked the receipt and the hole. He said he could not mend it that day. He offered a refund or a different colour. Lila chose the refund because she needed the money for the bus that week. Owen counted the notes into her hand. Lila checked the amount against the receipt before she walked away. She kept the receipt until the money was safe at home.
